Nutrition Coaching in Chicago

Guidance from certified trainers on what and how to eat, included with every plan at our private Lakeview studio.

Book your free first session

Transform Personal Training is a private, appointment-only personal training studio at 2900 N Broadway in Lakeview, Chicago. Every Transform trainer is certified in nutrition, and nutrition guidance is included with every training plan, not sold as an add-on. Online coaching clients also get a meal plan built around their goals and the food they actually eat.

Why nutrition is part of every plan

You train a few hours a week. You eat, sleep, sit and stress for the other 165. That's where most of your progress is won or lost, and you can't out-train a kitchen. So your trainer coaches you on both.

What nutrition coaching includes in the studio

  • Guidance from your trainer on what and how much to eat for your goals, whether that's losing weight, building strength or having more energy.
  • Better choices with the food you already like, restaurant dinners included. No fad diets.
  • Daily check-ins from your own trainer, so you get answers between sessions, not just during them.
  • A meal plan if you'd like one. Most studio clients do well with guidance alone, but just ask and your trainer will put one together.

Online coaching: meal plans included

Our online coaching includes a meal plan built around your goals and the food you actually eat, with tracking in the Trainerize app, plus a custom training program, daily check-ins and a weekly 1-on-1 video call. It's for US clients and starts at $127 a week. Kristen, our accountability and nutrition coach, focuses on the small daily habits that actually last.

Who guides you

Every Transform trainer is certified in nutrition. Meet the coaches:

Gerri Bushkovski

NASM Certified Personal Trainer, Corrective Exercise Specialist, Apex Nutrition Certified.

Miriam Plotkin

NASM Certified Personal Trainer, Advanced Sports Nutrition, training clients since 2001.

Eric-Todd Rushing

NASM Certified Personal Trainer and iPEC Certified Professional Coach, focused on the mental side of change.

Kristen

Nutrition Coach, Behavior Change Specialist, Accountability Specialist. Coaches online.

What nutrition coaching isn't

We're personal trainers, not medical providers. Our nutrition guidance is for everyday eating and fitness goals. If you have a medical condition that affects what you eat, or a doctor has you on a specific diet, follow your doctor's advice.

Price

Nutrition guidance costs nothing extra. It's part of every plan.

  • One-on-one training: $55 a session at twice a week, $50 at three times, $45 at four times. Every session is 30 minutes.
  • Online coaching, with a meal plan: from $127 a week.
  • First session: free.

Questions about nutrition coaching

Does nutrition coaching cost extra?

No. Nutrition guidance is included with every training plan, in the studio and online.

Do you provide meal plans?

Online coaching includes a meal plan built around your goals and the food you actually eat. In the studio, your trainer gives you nutrition guidance, and can put together a meal plan if you ask.

Are your trainers certified in nutrition?

Yes. Every Transform trainer is certified in nutrition, with credentials that include Apex Nutrition, Advanced Sports Nutrition and Nutrition Coach.

Will I have to give up foods I like?

No. There are no fad diets. Your trainer works with the food you actually eat, restaurant dinners included.

Can I get nutrition coaching without training?

Nutrition coaching comes with our studio training and our online coaching programs.

Can you help if I have a medical condition?

Our guidance is for everyday eating and fitness goals, not medical treatment. If your doctor has you on a specific diet, follow their advice, and tell us so your trainer can work around it.

How do the daily check-ins work?

Your trainer checks in with you every day by message, so you can ask questions and stay on track between sessions. Online clients do it through the Trainerize app.

Where are you located?

Our studio is at 2900 N Broadway in Lakeview, Chicago. Online coaching is available anywhere in the US.
